kind: scientific coding agent and owned execution runtime

runtime.execution: Provider-neutral synchronous Python engine, threaded provider/kernel control, JSON-lines persistent workers, SQLite host; TypeScript frontend.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns its per-session kernels and database; consumes model APIs, MCP and BYOC/SSH scientific compute. It is not evidence of Anthropic internals.

summary: An independent hybrid native-tool/code-cell agent with ledger reconstruction, compaction archives, generation-bound execution and conservative recovery.

inspection.scope: outer engine, native dispatch, kernel RPC/namespace, ledger/compaction/query, child controls, recovery and selected offline test assertions
inspection.limits: Source was inspected but never executed. Flagged auto-review/remote features are documented separately from traced default paths; update apply modules are absent from this pinned tree.

actions.name: AgentEngine.run
actions.output: EngineResult with messages, completion, stop_reason, turns and last reply.
actions.lifecycle: Synchronous state machine; cancelled/max_turns/no-progress are not completion.
actions.authority: Composition owner chooses ports; policy stays in adapters/dispatcher.

actions.name: native tool batch / execute_tool_call
actions.input: Provider-normalized IDs/raw+parsed arguments and session catalog.
actions.output: One paired observation/error per declaration, success indicator and durable action identity.
actions.lifecycle: Read-only leading calls may parallelize; mutation barrier retains provider order.
actions.authority: Schema/precheck then common host permission/egress/audit envelope.

actions.name: Python/R cell; host RPC
actions.input: First complete language cell; host.method arguments mid-Python-cell.
actions.output: Captured output/error/interrupt plus matching host_response data/error.
actions.lifecycle: Lazy persistent worker; manager sole read path; same-call correlation and generation bindings.
actions.authority: Worker execution and host capabilities are separate authorities; lone soft-error object raises.

actions.name: host.exec_background / exec_peek / exec_interrupt
actions.output: Immediate exec_id/status; accumulated bounded stdout; cancellation delivery verdict.
actions.lifecycle: Independent worker, manager-memory lifetime, not foreground namespace or durable daemon restart continuation.
actions.authority: Exact kernel object gets idempotent interrupt; no job from guessed display ID.

actions.name: send_message / stop_child / continue_child / materialize_child
actions.input: child_id, steering message, optional wait or artifact path selections.
actions.output: Queued message_id/delivery state; stopped/continued child result; materialized version refs.
actions.lifecycle: Subtree cancellation precedes signal; restart never automatically continues child provider work.
actions.authority: Parent owns direct child; publication uses recorded artifact identities.

actions.name: host.query
actions.input: Read-only SQL SELECT/CTE, parameters, optional row limit (default None), statement timeout (default five seconds) and host-derived scope.
actions.output: Rows or authorizer/timeout errors; omitted/falsy limit fetches all rows rather than imposing an output-row bound.
actions.lifecycle: Serialized statement on standing SQLite connection; authorizer bracket removed afterward.
actions.authority: Agent forbidden tables/CTE shadowing/writes refused; scoped views supplied by trusted host.

actions.name: create_checkpoint / fork_session / session_status
actions.input: Optional expected head; exactly one checkpoint/cell/message source and branch name.
actions.lifecycle: Append-only checkpoint; view-only branch; activation/replay remains distinct.
actions.authority: Current root session only; gateway supplies filesystem-aware domain.

actions.name: define_dynamic_tool / list_dynamic_tools / promote_dynamic_tool
actions.input: Name, schemas, Python execute(args), smoke_args and ttl_s; promotion scope.
actions.output: Scoped version/manifest catalogue or test/approval result (definition service not fully traced).
actions.lifecycle: One-shot sandbox execution declared; definition TTL and human promotion are explicit contract.
actions.authority: High-risk schema; promotion explicitly requires human approval; not engine refit.

filesystem.detail: Native write_file uses descriptor-anchored staging/publication; kernels and tools access their scoped workspace and versioned artifacts. This does not audit all arbitrary native extension IO.

processes.detail: Persistent kernel execution and separately identified background processes expose interruption; host RPC shares permission/generation context. Arbitrary shell process-tree proof is outside inspected lines.

code_actions.detail: One Python/R code cell is an engine action; native batches have priority and finalize is distinct. Python worker actually executes in persistent namespace; no LSP semantic engine is implied.

persistent_kernel.detail: Foreground worker namespace persists across cells; background execs have separate namespaces. Restart creates a candidate generation and only safe, verified replay can restore selected state; this is owned session computation, not an external shared kernel fabric.

standing_database.detail: SQLite host persists agent/control/scientific records and exposes read-only SELECT/CTE through host.query with scoped views and a real authorizer. Statement timeout defaults to five seconds; row limit is optional (None or another falsy limit fetches all rows). Generic mutating SQL and cross-user credential reads are not granted.

workflow_programming.detail: Engine ports, code-as-action and native tool metadata compose orchestration. The model can define sandboxed execute(args) tools, but promotion is human-governed and no general live workflow DSL is established here.

multi_model.detail: Provider selection and child overrides are part of composition; inspected child continuation/control handles are real. Full cross-provider peer collaboration is not established; model adapter can leave cancelled network work detached.

live_collaboration.detail: Parent can message child via queued message_id, stop subtree, explicitly continue or materialize child artifacts. This is a delegation tree, not a general peer room.

concurrent_work.detail: Read-only native waves and separate background workers/child futures coexist, with mutations ordered. Background records are in memory; trusted artifact capture can impose serial delegation (documented engine package contract).

steering_interrupt.detail: Engine checks cancellation before/after execution, provider cancellation stays monotonic, child stop publishes tree cancellation before signals, and background interrupt reports undelivered verdicts.

turn_redefinition.detail: Model/context/executor/interceptor/event/cancellation/completion ports define executable turn composition. This is an owned API seam; no live arbitrary replacement of an underway turn program was established.

compaction.detail: Budgeted head/handoff/tail transformation archives raw summarized slice, metadata and digest; ledger records handoff coverage transactionally. Preserving raw context enables later recovery without pretending the summary is original.

context_repair.detail: Raw compaction archive, canonical ledger history and exact session checkpoint/fork cursors provide repair inputs. Kernel recovery is separate conservative replay and may be partial; no automatic full conversation correction oracle is shown.

original_audit.detail: Append-oriented routed action/outcome/terminal records, raw native metadata and compaction archives preserve reconstructable histories. Redaction and bounded output/capture mean these are not every original provider byte/OS effect; mutable projections are separate.

audit_query.detail: Read-only SQL and current-session status/checkpoint/branch projection query durable records; team/scoped authorizer protects forbidden data. No global complete physical-execution view is implied.

hot_change.detail: Per-call schema source and current-session dynamic tool definition/promotion provide callable mutation points with explicit schemas and TTL. Dynamic execute(args) does not replace the running engine.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Durable history/checkpoint and candidate kernel recovery preserve selected local state; child restore requires explicit continuation. Pinned updater apply/relaunch transaction is absent, so discovery/verification must not be sold as working harness refit.

remote_services.detail: Official pinned docs describe consumed SSH/BYOC jobs and poll-driven verified harvest; relevant adapter implementation was not fully traced, and future provider list is explicitly excluded.

self_improvement.detail: Versioned dynamic tool definition is a model-facing extension primitive, not autonomous evaluation/improvement of the harness. Update machinery is deliberately unreachable from a turn.

complaints.detail: Diagnostics support bundles capture redacted operational state/logs for operator issues. They exclude research DB and do not automatically open a model complaint bead/external tracking row.

authority.detail: Native and in-kernel calls share permission/action/generation envelope, scoped SQL and current-root orchestration. Human-governed dynamic promotion and hard safety gates are stronger than the desired low-approval Arconaut posture.

evaluation.detail: Documented opt-in reviewer stages freeze evidence/identity and distinguish shadow from gated promotion; storage-only state must not count as executed review. Inspected offline tests exercise concrete routing/redaction/recovery/identity faults, not scientific general validity.

time_order.detail: Ordered native call ordinals/results, transactional compaction coverage and source/candidate generation identities provide explicit local causality. Correlated child messages and exact-owner interruption avoid recycled-event confusion; not a distributed universal clock.

evidence.claim: Engine composes model/context/executor/events/cancellation/completion ports; each turn prepares messages, completes provider, routes, executes, appends result and checks terminal state.
Code/native/finalize action types retain native wire ID, ordinal, raw arguments, parse errors and provider metadata.
Native invocation resolves catalog, validates/prechecks, dispatches and returns bounded observation plus success indicator; errors are observations.
Permission denial is soft failure; actual handler results are screened and host calls finally log action/permission/resource identities.
Provider calls select current tool schemas; detached cancellation is monotonic so a recycled session cancel event cannot revive old responses.
Mid-cell host RPC binds generation/action/sandbox context and returns same-call-ID data/error; a lone error object becomes worker error.
Cells compile/evaluate/execute in persistent _NS, latch signals before user statements and distinguish delivered interrupt from user-raised KeyboardInterrupt.
Native batches close each declaration and admit only leading positively read-only/non-conflicting calls to parallel waves; mutations are barriers.
Background code gets independent subprocess and exec_id, not the foreground namespace.
Background jobs live in manager memory and expose peek/idempotent interrupt with actual undelivered-signal diagnosis.
Child continuation is explicit after restart, publication materialization copies version refs, subtree cancellation publishes before signals, messages are queued with distinct IDs.
Ledger records user, routed action/outcome and terminal groups from engine events; stored user messages are redacted.
Compaction handoff plus covered-through-group/archive reference commit as one group/event transaction, leaving prior ledger history retained.
Context uses head/handoff/tail; raw summarized middle and summary are saved in digest-addressed JSON with branch/recovery metadata and before/after budgets.

host.query exposes read-only SELECT/CTE with real SQLite authorizer, scoped views, default five-second statement timeout and serialized shared connection; output-row limit is optional and omitted/falsy limit fetches all rows.
Recovery constructs distinct candidate generation and journals each phase with source/candidate/branch identity.
Replay verifies source hashes and safety; skipped/nonreplayable/failed steps yield partial and candidate is shut down rather than promoted.
Native session status/checkpoint/fork schemas expose exact source cursor and compare-and-swap head; model cannot choose arbitrary host root through these tools.
Model orchestration is bound to current root; filesystem-aware mutations need gateway domain service.
Native write_file stages and publishes through verified parent descriptor, preserving permissions and refusing partial-overwrite exposure.
Dynamic tool definition accepts Python execute(args), schemas/smoke arguments/TTL; promotion is explicitly human governed and declared high risk.
Pinned updater ships discovery/verification only; apply transaction and routes are planned, and model-turn imports are forbidden.
Flagged auto-mode stages distinguish storage-only/shadow review from gated promotion and frozen independent review snapshots; documentation is not default execution proof.
Documented BYOC/SSH stage/run/harvest consumer has explicit poll-driven harvest and remote timeout/group-cancellation; unsupported provider families remain future.
Diagnostics collects redacted bounded operational metadata and logs, deliberately excluding research database; this is a support bundle rather than automatic complaint submission.

tests.focus: Tool/code priority and false terminal success
tests.oracle: Scripted model/executor asserts native batch wins over a Python assertion fence, grouped tool call results retained, and plain prose ends max_turns with no completion. Adapter mocks do not prove actual worker execution.

tests.focus: Lost raw metadata or secrets in reconstructed history
tests.oracle: Real temporary SQLite store plus synthetic engine events asserts user/native/terminal groups, call-ID pairing and literal secret absence/redacted markers. This is deliberate transformed history, not original-byte audit.

tests.focus: Durable handoff lost after process-local Store closes
tests.oracle: Real SQLite close/reopen asserts reconstructed compacted history equality. It proves storage/reducer consistency, not that a model summary faithfully retained every fact.

tests.focus: Wrong owner/session/ticket cancellation and queue corruption
tests.oracle: Exact wrong-session, queued-ticket and wrong-owner requests must not set events; correct request cancels only active ticket and next FIFO ticket is admitted. This does not deliver OS signals.

tests.focus: Mutable sidecar replacing frozen recovery code
tests.oracle: Known old/new source bytes, manifest and generated bootstrap assert old module value/hash/origin despite changed disk. This independently selected literal oracle tests recovery provenance; not all scientific kernel state.

strengths: Small provider-neutral Python engine with explicit ports and deterministic action routing.
Canonical action ledger and raw compaction archive distinguish projection from history.
Candidate generation recovery rejects false successful restoration and explicit child continuation prevents replaying remote effects.
limits: Owned per-session kernels/database differ from Arconaut consuming shared computation.
Redaction, bounded channels and capture coverage still prevent universal original audit.
Opt-in staged auto-mode contracts and absent updater apply paths must not be equated with default autonomous repair/refit.
arconaut_questions: Can Arconaut make context transformation a recorded event referencing immutable originals while allowing model repair?
How will provider cancellation distinguish detached but still-billable requests from quiescent refit readiness?
Which service handles must preserve request identity separately from attempts across explicit continuation?
